# FreeMap

> A live, interactive map of free stuff listed on Craigslist in Vancouver, BC.
> Free furniture, electronics, building materials, moving boxes, bikes and more
> appear on the map in real time — each pin has a photo, neighbourhood, how long
> ago it was posted, and a link to the original Craigslist post. Free to use.

FreeMap reads Craigslist's public free section for Vancouver and plots it on a
dark, interactive map. Pins are colour-coded by how recently each item was
posted and fade away when a listing disappears. Users can filter by category or
distance and save finds. FreeMap links out to Craigslist; contacting a poster
happens on Craigslist.

## Use it
- [FreeMap (live map)](https://craigslistmap.lettergen.io/): the app.

## Common questions it answers
- How can I find free stuff in Vancouver?
- Where can I get free furniture near me in Vancouver?
- Is there a map of Craigslist free listings?
- How do I find free moving boxes, firewood, or building materials in Vancouver?

## About
- [Source code on GitHub](https://github.com/viviannnl/freemap): how it works.
- Coverage: Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada.
- Categories: furniture, electronics, materials, boxes, bikes, appliances,
  plants, kids, books, kitchen, clothing, and other free items.
